wellbeing.title: Wellbeing
wellbeing.subtitle: A calm space to check in, reset, and find balance: supportive, never graded

wellbeing.moodFeedbackOkay: Thanks: noticing ups and downs is a kind step.

wellbeing.balanceTrackedOnly: Tracked only while Stuvo tab is active (via Page Visibility API). We never claim time outside the app.
wellbeing.balanceCountsTime: Counts time in Study Hub / Homework / Revision vs Community. Not outside-app activity.
wellbeing.wellbeingAssistantSubtitle: A supportive space to reflect: not a counselor, not a diagnosis.
